treatments.label: Monitor NERC Reliability Assessments for regional planning-reserve-margin erosion
Track FERC seasonal reliability assessments for grid-stress flags

implementationSteps.step: Compute reserve margin = unused capacity at peak / expected peak demand (NERC method)
Identify regions where demand growth + supply outages push margins below the reference target

evidenceAnchors.product: Energy Market and Electric Reliability Assessment

mechanismCandidates.mechanism: Sustained combined stress (high demand + structural strain + outages) erodes the planning reserve margin (unused capacity at peak / peak demand); as margin falls below the reference target, shortfall risk rises
Regional reserve erosion under extreme scenarios (demand increase + supply outages) can cascade into operating-reserve shortfalls
